training_description: offline safety-layer design plus simulation-based Residual SAC pre-training; this is not fixed-dataset offline RL

training_trend_summary.evaluation_source: fixed-seed paired deterministic Hinf-RPI zero-residual versus SAC

nominal_safe_steady_reference.interpretation: evaluation-only nominal safe steady reference, not a global optimal policy

theta_learning.continuous_K_parameterization: direct unconstrained real 2x2 entries with two-sided pattern search; acceptance constrained by the complete safety gate
theta_learning.safe_acceptance_gate: all retained residuals in W_theta; stable A+BK; nonempty tightened input/state sets and controlled-invariant set; actual zero-residual verification QP feasible; nonzero state-dependent residual authority at S center/vertices

legacy_2020_ablation_context.name: paper_inspired_theta_ablation
legacy_2020_ablation_context.scope: paper-aligned center, linear steady input, disturbance ranges, constraints, economic cost, and theta=(h,p,M,K); SAC replaces the paper's Q-learning and the one-step invariant QP replaces its full robust MPC horizon
legacy_2020_ablation_context.comparison_limit: the paper plots initial/final sets but does not tabulate their areas; no numeric paper area is fabricated

paper2016_comparison.rho_d_scope: separate four-exogenous-disturbance robustness/applicability analysis; excluded from the Paper2016 fair comparison

tolerance_definition.reference: method-specific mean over the final 20 s of the fixed 300 s rollout
tolerance_definition.band: 5% of the maximum absolute post-last-shock deviation from that reference
tolerance_definition.settling_time: first elapsed second after t=40 s for which every remaining sample stays inside the fixed 5% band; null if never settled

empirical_method_specific.tolerance: 5% of that method's own maximum absolute deviation after the final shock

common_paired_reference.reference: the paired zero-residual baseline final-20-s mean, used unchanged for both SAC and zero residual
common_paired_reference.tolerance: 5% of the zero-residual baseline's maximum absolute post-last-shock deviation, used unchanged for both methods
common_paired_reference.purpose: controller-to-controller recovery comparison without method-specific reference drift

paper2016_G.reason: No validated same-scenario Economic MPC cumulative-cost result is available in this run; G is intentionally not fabricated.

tunempc_dependency_diagnostics.note: TuneMPC declares Python >=3.5,<3.8 and pins casadi==3.5.1 and picos==1.2.0.post32. A newer interpreter may work only with a separately validated compatibility environment.

required_fields.sum_P_s: sum of steady economic costs over identical samples

rl_vs_no_rl.comparison_design: paired original Paper2016 state-shock scenarios under identical nominal exogenous conditions; safe_SAC uses the same optimized fixed safety design as theta_only; only the SAC residual differs. no_RL uses the initial unoptimized design

sac_state_dependence.interpretation: near-zero requested peak-to-peak means a constant residual bias; larger values demonstrate state-dependent actor feedback

disturbance_adaptation_evaluation.reason: four-exogenous-disturbance robustness/adaptation belongs to the separate rho_d applicability analysis

paper2016_proposed_training_reward_scope: replay reward only; RPI event/excess remain computed and remain in fixed evaluation reporting and formal safety certification
continuous_penalty_form: negative_weighted_squared_L2; state/input/RPI use normalized positive-part excess beyond their bounds
event_penalty_form: fixed_nonnegative_penalty; squaring a Boolean indicator is identical
reward_sign_note: positive reward only means the observed stage cost improvement over the fixed nominal-economic baseline exceeds the nonnegative penalties; the economic action ordering remains unambiguous

feedback_control_law.control_structure: v_base is safe-center finite-horizon tracking in proposed mode (learned affine h,p guidance in joint_theta); nominal z is projected into S on reset; base = safe projection(v_base) with reserved residual-box margin; candidate = declared feasible residual parameterization(base, actor_action); v_qp = safety verification projection(candidate); u_normalized = v_qp + K(x-z)
feedback_control_law.safety_filter_type: learned finite-horizon nominal guidance plus RPI tightening and one-step invariant QP
feedback_control_law.K_parameterization: continuous real 2x2 gain with H-infinity/RPI/QP safety-gated offline geometry search and fixed SAC deployment

disturbance_bound_method: four-facet asymmetric W_theta={w|Mw<=m} certified on the final robust operating region X_R x U_R x D; region scale is expanded geometrically and backed off by bisection at the first infeasible H-infinity/RPI/tightening/invariant candidate
replay_action_execution_mask: one for the declared feasible action parameterization; zero only if the verification QP fails and its fallback replaces the action
safe_action_parameterization: state-dependent symmetric residual box scaled by current polytope slack
input_move_penalty_scope: change in executed SAC residual only; excludes nominal and H-infinity motion
warmup_update_order: use uniform random actions until warmup_steps while SAC updates begin as soon as replay contains one minibatch
empirical_regret_definition: post-hoc normalized gap of best-so-far fixed-seed deterministic evaluation to the best evaluation observed in this run; it is not the training reward or a theoretical optimality certificate
